title: The Ellis Larkin trio album, her best, and poor pressings
summary: She worked with Ellis Larkin on the International album, judges it her best, but poor vinyl made the needle skate.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums
